info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Ecommerce Cart Remove-v5-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Removal API allows businesses to effectively manage their online shopping carts by removing items. This operation is essential for ensuring that customers can easily discard unwanted products from their cart, enhancing the shopping experience. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and mobile apps that facilitate online shopping. The API supports removal actions for individual items or multiple products within the cart, allowing for seamless inventory management and customer satisfaction.

delete.summary: Remove an item from the cart.
delete.description: This endpoint allows users to remove a specified item from their shopping cart. Ensure that the item exists in the cart before attempting to remove it.

requestBody.description: Request body for removing an item from the shopping cart. The payload should specify the necessary details to identify the item to be removed, ensuring the appropriate operation is executed.

204.description: The item has been successfully removed from the cart.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveRequest.description: Request body for removing an item from the cart. The value should be a string indicating the item to be removed.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_204.title: Cart Removal Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cart removal was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the removal request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the cart after the removal operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the removal request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the removal operation.

audit.description: Audit details for the removal operation.

DeleteEcommerceCartRemoveResponse_204.description: Response schema for the cart removal operation that indicates the status and details of the removal process.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that executed the removal.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the removal operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Details related to the audit of the cart removal operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
